note: Original pattern annotations of inspected pinned upstream documents, not copied components. Pattern references are read-only and do not authorize a competing library.

patterns.fit: Whole page or new visual world: derive materially different structures from content and user goals; replace old composition, not product truth.
patterns.section: Decide what is already true; Choose the right amount of invention
patterns.avoid: Not for a narrow extension; do not run upstream scripts or require additional approvals blindly.

patterns.fit: Reading order, grouping, topology and density; asymmetric experience/marketing composition vs stable operational layout.
patterns.section: Visitor mode; Set the spatial thesis; Verify

patterns.fit: Swipe carousel composition, size, orientation, options, events and RTL; consider peek, vertical, indexed or multi-item navigation.

patterns.fit: Carousel for Base UI variant; exact component primitives, sizes, orientation, events and RTL.

patterns.fit: Asymmetric feature layout, one dominant panel and supporting tiles; evaluate content-driven spans or vertical variant.
patterns.avoid: Not a default for every section; avoid equal card wallpaper or gratuitous effects.

patterns.fit: Progress feedback for long narrative; combine with real content milestones only when useful.
patterns.avoid: Not a substitute for navigation; no forced scroll hijacking.

patterns.fit: Sequence of events/notifications for an illustrative product or timeline section.
patterns.avoid: Never delay essential content, fake live data or force repeated motion.

patterns.fit: Optional continuous decorative partner strip; vertical or horizontal variants.
patterns.avoid: Do not use for critical reading or primary navigation; pause/control and reduced motion required.

patterns.fit: Plan lead/follow, overlap, exits and interruption; synchronize to the event that matters.

patterns.avoid: Not generic stagger or animation of every child.

patterns.fit: Drag/swipe that tracks input, release physics and interruptibility; compare existing primitives.

patterns.fit: Business-specific page architecture and visual rhythm, relevant official example gallery.
patterns.section: The page plan by kind; What serves which page
patterns.avoid: Marketing-only style rules must not displace functional product requirements.

patterns.fit: Indexed content panels, horizontal/vertical tabs, changing focal content while maintaining context.
patterns.avoid: Use when categories are genuine; preserve deep links and keyboard navigation.

patterns.fit: Progressive disclosure; replace equal-card groups with a scan-friendly vertical hierarchy.
patterns.avoid: Do not hide important comparisons or required disclosures.

patterns.fit: Master-detail / configurable panels with keyboard resize support.
patterns.avoid: Not appropriate for simple marketing sections or mobile-only views.

patterns.fit: Native-scroll rail with horizontal option; content overview without one-card-at-a-time carousel.
patterns.avoid: Avoid nested scroll traps and inaccessible offscreen content.

patterns.fit: Grouped navigation and link composition; make section exploration explicit.
patterns.avoid: Do not change routes/permissions or replace accessible native navigation unnecessarily.
